name: dev-toolkit
description: Reusable Claude Code plugins for day-to-day software work — spec-driven change workflows, service knowledge bases, AWS operations, git guardrails, notes, and command-line drills.

plugins.name: market-analysis
plugins.description: Checks for people who use Python to analyse markets but don't read Python — audits technical-analysis and screening code for the data, indicator, and screener faults that make results look cleaner than reality, and reports them in terms of the result.

plugins.name: notes-workflow
plugins.description: Daily-log lifecycle and task-file upkeep, meeting and people capture, plus a capture/recall memory workflow over a markdown notes vault. Creates the vault for you on first use.

plugins.name: cli-tools-drill
plugins.description: Interactive drills for learning the basic Linux command-line toolkit — each skill guides the agent through practice exercises for a group of related tools.

plugins.name: git-guardrails
plugins.description: Hooks that block the agent from destructive git operations (history-rewriting pushes, hard resets, working-tree wipes), remote deletion of protected branches, hand-edits to .git/, and pushing a commit that adds a credential. Pure Python, no dependencies.
